title: Art Basel Week Guide
igCaption:
Art Basel Miami Beach 2026 announced 272 exhibitors and a reconfigured showfloor.
The week also spreads through the Miami Design District and Wynwood with fairs, museums, parties, panels and satellite fairs.
What stop should we cover first this year?

Sources: Art Basel, The Art Newspaper, Miami Herald, The Miami Guide, Forbes, NBC 6 South Florida, Time Out Worldwide

#ArtBasel #MiamiArtWeek #MiamiBeach #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: Art Basel week starts at the Miami Beach Convention Center. The 2026 Miami Beach edition announced 272 exhibitors.
Art Basel announced 272 exhibitors for its 2026 Miami Beach edition, with a reconfigured showfloor. That changes the main fair layout before you get through the doors.

scenes.text: The main gallery sector and floorplan are scaling down for 2026. The fair also pushed the city for lower rent.

scenes.text: Head to the Miami Design District for fairs, museums, and design programming. It is one of the places that fills the rest of Art Week. If you’re there, check NEAR later to see who else was around.

scenes.text: Wynwood is where the satellite fairs land. Time Out tracks them for Art Basel week, and NBC 6 points to fairs and panels across the city.

scenes.text: Which stop should we build a full Art Week route around? It’s the same feeling as passing someone all week at Art Basel and never catching their name, which is exactly what NEAR helps make clear.
